node_wake.speaker: Elora
node_wake.text: You're finally awake! Where in the gods' names were you last night? You were called to the keep at midnight, and stumbled in before dawn covered in ash and blood! What happened?!

choices.text: I... I honestly don't remember anything after midnight.
Ash and blood?! Is anyone harmed in the village?
Calm down. Let me grab my service blade from the footlocker.

node_amnesia.speaker: Elora
node_amnesia.text: Amnesia?! You looked like a ghost when you staggered through the door! Grab your sword from the footlocker and check on Captain Malakor at the garrison!

choices.text: I will. Stay inside and bolt the door.

node_danger.speaker: Elora
node_danger.text: The village was silent, but strange howling echoed from the woods. Please, take your blade and be careful.

choices.text: I'm heading out now.

node_arm_up.speaker: Elora
node_arm_up.text: Your blade is in your footlocker, along with a healing draught. Find out what madness gripped the keep last night.

choices.text: Understood.

node_exit.speaker: Elora
node_exit.text: May the light watch over you, Lieutenant.

node_blacksmith_start.speaker: Blacksmith Brand
node_blacksmith_start.text: Lieutenant! By the forge, you're alive! What in the Hells occurred at the garrison last night?!

choices.text: Tell me what you saw, Brand.
The garrison gates are barred. Can you help me enter?

node_tell_me.speaker: Blacksmith Brand
node_tell_me.text: Captain Malakor's unit hauled a warded sarcophagus from the crypts past midnight. You were with them, Lieutenant! But your eyes were glazed over with violet light! Then screams came from the keep...

choices.text: Give me the side-gate key. I need to get inside.

node_give_key.speaker: Blacksmith Brand
node_give_key.text: Here! Take my side-gate maintenance key. The main portcullis is deadlocked. Be careful in there... the guards didn't sound human anymore.

choices.text: Thank you, Brand. Stay inside.

node_malakor_start.speaker: Captain Malakor
node_malakor_start.text: Ah... my faithful Lieutenant returns. Do you remember now? The Azrath relic has opened my eyes! Together we shall shatter the old order!

choices.text: You've been corrupted by the vault, Captain. Stand down!
What was inside that sarcophagus?!

node_lore.speaker: Captain Malakor
node_lore.text: The primordial slumber of ancient gods! It chose me as its vessel—and you were the one who broke the first seal!

choices.text: Then I will be the one who ends this madness!

node_defiance.speaker: Captain Malakor
node_defiance.text: Disobedience is treason in the Royal Guard, Lieutenant. Perish with the weak!

choices.text: [Draw Weapon] To arms!

node_fight.speaker: Captain Malakor
node_fight.text: Death to all who defy the Void!

title: Barkeep Corwin at the Rusty Dragon

node_welcome.speaker: Barkeep Corwin
node_welcome.text: Welcome to The Rusty Dragon Inn, Lieutenant! The hearth is warm, but rumors are grim. Howlers are creeping out from the Whispering Forest to the east.

choices.text: Tell me about the Whispering Forest.
Have you seen Captain Malakor today?
Just passing through.

node_forest.speaker: Barkeep Corwin
node_forest.text: The eastern path crosses an ancient stone bridge into the woods. Beyond the ruins lies the entrance to the Catacombs. Travelers haven't returned.

choices.text: I will proceed with caution.

node_malakor.speaker: Barkeep Corwin
node_malakor.text: The Captain hasn't been seen since the midnight bell. He ordered the portcullis bolted and barred. It isn't like him.

choices.text: I'll find out what happened.

node_end.speaker: Barkeep Corwin
node_end.text: Stay safe, Lieutenant. The village is counting on you.

node_welcome.speaker: Guildmaster Aldous
node_welcome.text: Lieutenant Vance! Thank the heavens. The merchant guild is panicked—the royal keep was shuttered at midnight, and foul shadows stalk the periphery.

choices.text: I intend to breach the keep and investigate.
Are the village trade routes secure?

node_duty.speaker: Guildmaster Aldous
node_duty.text: Speak to Blacksmith Brand across the square. He forged the backup garrison key. Take it and unlock the gate!

choices.text: On my way, Guildmaster.

node_trade.speaker: Guildmaster Aldous
node_trade.text: The northern passes are blocked, and eastern forest trade is halted by dire wolves. Clear the road if you can!

choices.text: Understood.

node_welcome.speaker: Maybelle the Apothecary
node_welcome.text: Careful out there, soldier! I've been brewing soothing poultices all night. The darkness that fell over the keep isn't natural.

choices.text: Do you have healing draughts in stock?
What did you observe last night?

node_potions.speaker: Maybelle the Apothecary
node_potions.text: Take this flask of red draught. It will close wounds in the heat of battle.

choices.text: Thank you, Maybelle.

node_shadows.speaker: Maybelle the Apothecary
node_shadows.text: Purple lightning struck the keep's tower at the stroke of twelve. Then came the wailing...

choices.text: We will put an end to it.

node_end.speaker: Maybelle the Apothecary
node_end.text: May the herbs keep you whole.

node_welcome.speaker: Gate Guard Garrick
node_welcome.text: Halt! The Royal Garrison Keep is locked by decree of Captain Malakor. None may pass without the garrison key!

choices.text: I serve the crown, Garrick. What happened inside?
I have the garrison key.

node_info.speaker: Gate Guard Garrick
node_info.text: Captain Malakor took a detachment down into the lower crypts and sealed the doors from within. When he returned, his eyes glowed with shadow.

choices.text: I'll get to the bottom of this.

node_pass.speaker: Gate Guard Garrick
node_pass.text: If you hold the key, unlock the portcullis and tread carefully, Lieutenant.

node_welcome.speaker: Farmer Giles
node_welcome.text: My barley fields are trampled, and two sheep were butchered in the dark! Shadows with fangs, I swear it!

choices.text: Stay inside, Giles. We will purge the beasts.

node_end.speaker: Farmer Giles
node_end.text: Thank the gods for the Royal Guard. Drive 'em back into the woods!

node_welcome.speaker: Sister Althea
node_welcome.text: May divine grace shelter you from the shadow. An ancient seal has broken deep in the catacombs.

choices.text: Grant us your blessing, Sister.

node_bless.speaker: Sister Althea
node_bless.text: Go with the light, brave heroes. Let no darkness consume your courage.

node_welcome.speaker: Miller Hob
node_welcome.text: The mill stream is running dark and brackish, straight from the eastern ridge. Something wicked is poisoning the water.

choices.text: We will find the source.

node_welcome.speaker: Ranger Kaelen
node_welcome.text: Watch yourself beyond the eastern arch. The Whispering Forest is crawling with blighted wolves and goblin scouts.

choices.text: Where does the forest path lead?

node_path.speaker: Ranger Kaelen
node_path.text: Follow the stone bridge across the stream. Up the mossy slope sits the entrance to the Ancient Catacombs.

node_welcome.speaker: Lyra the Minstrel
node_welcome.text: ♪ Shadows rise upon the keep, while the ancient guardians sleep... ♪ A thrilling and terrible ballad, is it not?

choices.text: Sing of our victory, Lyra, not our doom.

node_ballad.speaker: Lyra the Minstrel
node_ballad.text: ♪ Then strike the foe with sword and spell, and send the darkness back to hell! ♪ Bring us glory, Lieutenant!

node_welcome.speaker: Trader Borin
node_welcome.text: Finest supplies in Oakhaven! Potions, arrows, torches, and enchanted parchment.

choices.text: Keep your goods safe until the keep is secured.

node_end.speaker: Trader Borin
node_end.text: Fair travels and fat purses, friend!

node_welcome.speaker: Elder Martha
node_welcome.text: I was a girl when the ancient crypts were sealed. The royal founders buried a void relic beneath the garrison. If it stirs, the realm falls.

choices.text: We will seal it once more, Elder.

node_end.speaker: Elder Martha
node_end.text: May the ancestors guide your blade, Vance.

node_welcome.speaker: Goblin Peddler Griknok
node_welcome.text: Hehehe! Shinies, trinkets, magic scrolls found in ancient moss! Friendly goblin, no bite, only trade!

choices.text: What are you doing so close to the ruins?

node_scavenge.speaker: Goblin Peddler Griknok
node_scavenge.text: Big wolves scared Griknok up a tree! Take magic scroll, kill nasty alpha wolf for Griknok!

node_welcome.speaker: Fallen Adventurer Rickard
node_welcome.text: Cough... beware... the catacombs beneath the forest... the skeleton archers guard the crypt key...

choices.text: Rest easy, soldier. We will reclaim the crypt.

node_end.speaker: Fallen Adventurer Rickard
node_end.text: Take my spare draught from the grass... avenge us...

node_welcome.speaker: Hermit Varis
node_welcome.text: The roots groan... ancient stone cries out. The catacombs below bleed shadow into the forest soil.

choices.text: How do we purge the corruption?

node_purge.speaker: Hermit Varis
node_purge.text: Slay the corruption at its heart in the keep. Let the light pierce the dark!

node_welcome.speaker: Spirit of Sir Justin
node_welcome.text: Who awakens the resting dead? If you bear the blood of the righteous, claim the sacred relic and cleanse the citadel above!

choices.text: We will honor your legacy, Sir Justin.

node_honor.speaker: Spirit of Sir Justin
node_honor.text: Take the royal signet from the grand sarcophagus. Let justice be delivered!
